I pick from the digest each round

qaLog.question: Accept the eight remaining rulings (R3-R10) as written?

claims.claim: Digest = {game, round, clips, commentary, built_at, compilation_id, compilation_version, asset_id, lane}; no findings/beats/phases and no digest version field
digest_leaks scans every string (min_len 12) and publish_round raises DigestLeakError before upload
parse_timeline handles only CHAMPION_KILL, BUILDING_KILL, ELITE_MONSTER_KILL, GAME_END; positions (per-minute and per-kill) are never read; OwnerFrame = minute/gold/cs/level
fights() chains kills within gap_s=15; fight_window pads 4/8 s pre, 3 s post, game_end+1 cap, ranker widen 5 s
FIGHT_CHAPTER_MAX_S=45 trims chapter starts; _merge_overlaps joins touching chapters; _trim drops by kill count to max_s=360; LANE_BEFORE_S=14 min; titles fall back to clean_title of the payoff beat

ClipAnalysis prompt asks for 4-12 s windows, 30 frames per clip, sidecar cache keyed by effective_prompt_version+model; watch_montage 1 fps 2x2 panels max 30, Valorant-specific prompt; vlm_anthropic_model=claude-haiku-4-5; cost_cap_per_asset_usd=2.0; story_budget_usd=5.0
effective_prompt_version = sha1(RUBRIC_VERSION + hint file + top-K=12 corrections)[:12]; corrections from WORKSPACE/game_hints/league_examples.jsonl (15 rules)

build_custom_montage trims each clip to the analyzer primary moment; _apply_window_fix_to_clip compounds offsets across refine iterations (jhin_pick 19 s -> 9 s -> 1 s); beat snap moves ends only; max_seconds is an ffmpeg -t tail cut
Owner bar only, ROI (465,690,350,10) uncalibrated, step 1.5 s, flags hp_reader_shadow/hp_reader_enabled default False
gaming-expert returns per clip quality/story_beats (free text with setup:/payoff: prefixes)/talking_points; no play type or phase; ADC dictionary empty

Jhin timeline: 36 frames at 60000 ms, gameDuration 2054, participantFrames carry position/championStats/damageStats; CHAMPION_KILL carries position and victimDamageDealt/Received; 49 kills, 11 elite kills, 2 DRAGON_SOUL_GIVEN, 263 WARD_PLACED, 58 TURRET_PLATE_DESTROYED

Proposer prototype on the Jhin timeline yields phases early 0-840 (14:00), mid 840-1463.3, late 1463.3-2054 (first baron); 21 fights, 13 owner-involved; p15 = teamfight 5v4 mid_lane initiator_kill won 4-1 at game 1412.4 s

redTeamFindings.title: Story planner 45 s cap and overlap merge throw away the approach
redTeamFindings.resolution: R2: plays are chapters 1:1, no cap, never merged, drop whole plays by rank

redTeamFindings.title: Riot cannot prove 2v3, flank, late jungler
redTeamFindings.resolution: R1: Riot lower bound, VLM confirms or null

redTeamFindings.title: Approach scan fails when the owner is dead or off-screen
redTeamFindings.resolution: R3: fallback first kill - 8 s, approach_unconfirmed, story only

redTeamFindings.title: Play text trips the digest leak check and blocks the round
redTeamFindings.resolution: R4: templated facts only in the digest; VLM prose local

redTeamFindings.title: Offset drift lands windows on the wrong footage
redTeamFindings.resolution: R5: per-play banner re-anchor; offset_uncertain excluded from shorts/montage

redTeamFindings.title: YAML edits and corrections stale every cached analysis
redTeamFindings.resolution: R6: plays frozen per game with their YAML hash; re-run on demand

redTeamFindings.title: Monthly montage pool assumes old footage exists
redTeamFindings.resolution: R7: pinned month-pool folder cut at analysis time, protected from cleanup

redTeamFindings.title: Precision test has no label format, matcher or pass bar
redTeamFindings.resolution: R8: labels.json, 50% overlap + 5 s start, precision >= 0.8 gate

redTeamFindings.title: Jump cuts vs end-only beat snap vs kaching timing
redTeamFindings.resolution: R9: only the outcome cut snaps; inner cuts at kill times; kaching after remap

redTeamFindings.title: Phase fallbacks break for early surrenders and 6-minute towers
redTeamFindings.resolution: R10: early ends at max(first tower, 8:00) or 14:00; two-phase games; closeout in the end phase

rulingsNote: R1 and R2 answered by the owner individually; R3-R10 proposed by the session and accepted by the owner in one batch ('Accept all eight').
